description: The pie chart represents the token routing distribution, comparing the proportions of different categories. The chart is divided into three slices. The largest slice, labeled "LOCAL" and colored green, occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart. The second-largest slice, labeled "LLM" and colored red, accounts for around 3.9%. The smallest slice, labeled "EDGE_P2P" and colored blue, makes up about 1.6%. The percentage labels are displayed inside the slices. The slices are arranged in descending order of their proportions, with the largest slice first. No legend is present in the chart, and none of the slices are visually emphasized.
